description: Closed gabriel_agent contract (ADR-26): a verified state checkpoint of the journal. It binds a journal sequence (head and inputs head of the chains at that sequence), the identities the state was produced with (reducer, schema registry, codec, the catalog in force at the sequence) and a retained state: one content-addressed object per run projection as of the sequence, listed by a checkpoint-state object (state_ref). A checkpoint is recorded only at the end of a recorded replay that reached its sequence from genesis or from an earlier verified checkpoint (verified_from), so the retained state is the state that replay reproduced. Cross-record rules are enforced by the owner.

catalog_digest.description: the catalog digest in force at the sequence (the epoch's), so a checkpoint is usable only while the epoch it was taken in reads the same

dependency_manifest_ref.description: optional: a manifest of what the checkpoint depends on, retained by the operator

events_reduced.description: events the recording replay re-reduced (all of them from genesis, or those after verified_from)

projection_digest.description: digest of {run_id: projection digest} over every run at the sequence; each projection digest is the sha256 of its retained projection object

state_ref.description: the gabriel.checkpoint-state/1 object listing every run's retained projection object

verified_from.description: 'genesis' when the recording replay started from the first event, else the checkpoint_id it started from

title: checkpoint
